blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, ZAMBOANGA DEL SUR, Philippines — A total of 244 foreigners, mostly Chinese nationals, were arrested on Friday in what authorities called the “largest Pogo bust” yet, two years after the ban on Philippine offshore gaming operators (Pogos).
